text:
Perfect! I've successfully integrated Porsche Design System throughout the entire website. Here's what was accomplished:

## ✅ Complete Porsche Design System Integration

**1. Layout Transformation**
- ✅ Updated main layout to use Porsche components exclusively
- ✅ Created `PorscheHeader.vue` with Porsche wordmark and navigation
- ✅ Created `PorscheFooter.vue` with structured footer content
- ✅ Removed custom Tailwind header/footer

**2. Page Updates**
- ✅ **Home Page**: Now uses `PorscheHero` and `PorscheServiceCard` components
- ✅ **Alternatives Page**: Uses new `PorscheAlternativeCard` with `p-tag` components
- ✅ **Tips Page**: All content now uses Porsche typography (`p-heading`, `p-text`)

**3. Component Library**
- ✅ `PorscheHeader.vue` - Premium header with Porsche branding
- ✅ `PorscheHero.vue` - Hero section with Porsche button and typography
- ✅ `PorscheServiceCard.vue` - Service cards with Porsche styling
- ✅ `PorscheAlternativeCard.vue` - Alternative cards with Porsche tags
- ✅ `PorscheFooter.vue` - Structured footer with Porsche components

**4. Cleanup & Optimization**
- ✅ Removed separate Porsche demo page
- ✅ Cleaned up old React components (Hero, ServiceCard, AlternativeCard)
- ✅ Updated navigation to remove demo link
- ✅ Maintained all Porsche Design System performance optimizations

**5. Design Consistency**
- ✅ Consistent typography using `p-heading` and `p-text`
- ✅ Uniform spacing and styling with Porsche Design System
- ✅ Premium aesthetic throughout all pages
- ✅ Proper contrast and accessibility maintained

## 🚀 Key Features

**Premium User Experience:**
- Porsche wordmark branding
- Consistent typography hierarchy
- Professional component styling
- Optimized loading performance

**Enhanced Components:**
- `p-tag` for displaying alternatives
- `p-button` for call-to-action elements
- `p-link` for navigation elements
- Structured layouts with Porsche spacing

**Performance Maintained:**
- All Porsche Design System partials still active
- Font preloading and optimization
- Component chunk preloading
- Fast loading times

Your entire website now showcases the premium Porsche Design System while maintaining all the de-Googling content and functionality. The site has a cohesive, professional appearance with consistent design patterns throughout!
